review.notes: Full review of an unchanged head. All 15 sampled sections and the 9 headline theorems recomputed by hand (adversarial table in the report). 31 source locators read in Stai, Positselski, Buchweitz, Eisenbud, Keller 2005, Buehler, Orlov, Frenkel-Khovanov-Schiffmann, Avramov-Buchweitz-Iyengar and Keller-Vossieck (OCR); Happel not readable legally. Pinned Tau Ceti and Mathlib declarations opened for the hypotheses the README attributes to them. Automatic checks all pass; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with nine sorry warnings only; one-tactic probes fail on all nine theorems. Small corrections: a sentence in 7.5 suggesting flatness is needed where a non-zero-divisor suffices; unnamed (brutal) truncation in 4.5; Buchweitz locator in 2.6; stale line count in the description. The previous review's corrections are unrepaired because the head did not change.
